display.purpose: Rare page-scale type. Not a table face.

title.purpose: Ledger cell and compound title — the table’s reading size.

body.purpose: Surrounding desk copy, not grid facts.

label.purpose: Sentence-case column headers in Plex Condensed.

mono.purpose: SKUs, serials, qty, money — strings an operator retypes.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: In-flow cards on canvas. Ambient layer keeps tall sheets readable at the top edge.

motion.name: color-only
motion.purpose: Chrome hover is color, never layout. Nothing that moves a neighbour.

components.name: Desk card
components.description: Pointer-desk sheet shell — square top, 12px floor, grid bleeds to the edges.
components.css: .ds-desk-card { background: var(--ds-color-background-surface, #ffffff); border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-desk-toolbar { height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-color-border-default, #cbd5e1); font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-color-text-secondary, #475569); } .ds-desk-grid { padding: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-color-text-primary, #0f172a); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-color-border-subtle, #e2e8f0); }

components.name: Column header
components.description: Sentence-case black micro label — click-to-sort, never grey, never uppercase.
components.css: .ds-table-header { appearance: none; background: var(--ds-color-background-surface, #ffffff); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-color-border-subtle, #e2e8f0); height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ds-color-text-primary, #0f172a); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-table-header:hover { background: var(--ds-color-surface-hover, #f8fafc); } .ds-table-header:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-fill-info, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compound title
components.description: Ledger cell title — slate idle, scan-blue underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-compound-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ds-color-text-primary, #0f172a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-compound-title:hover, .ds-compound-title:focus-visible { color: var(--ds-color-text-info, #2563eb); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar search
components.description: 28px search in the table toolbar — 8px corners, no underline.
components.css: .ds-toolbar-search { height: 28px; width: 100%; max-width: 22rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-color-text-primary, #0f172a); background: var(--ds-color-background-surface, #ffffff); } .ds-toolbar-search::placeholder { color: var(--ds-color-text-faint, #94a3b8); } .ds-toolbar-search:hover { background: var(--ds-color-surface-hover, #f8fafc); } .ds-toolbar-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-fill-info, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chrome button
components.description: Quiet toolbar control — part of the bar, not a CTA.
components.css: .ds-chrome-button { appearance: none; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-color-text-secondary, #475569); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chrome-button:hover { background: var(--ds-color-surface-hover, #f8fafc); color: var(--ds-color-text-primary, #0f172a); } .ds-chrome-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-fill-info, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: ID chip
components.description: Dense mono identifier — tabular, no tracking tighten.
components.css: .ds-id-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ds-color-text-info, #2563eb); background: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
Cycle Forge desks are a workbench spreadsheet sitting on cool slate canvas — not a document, not a scan bench. The slot data table (To-ship / Orders and every PRODUCT_TABLES peer) is the identity lock: one white card, caption-dense rows, hairline bottom rules, black sentence-case headers that sort on click. Chrome is quiet; facts carry the story.

Personality is ops density with Linear chrome discipline. Hierarchy comes from ink contrast and tracking, never from weight 700 or a second display face. The table is coplanar with its toolbar and status bar; depth is the card on the canvas, not nested islands inside the grid.

Confirmed visual rejections: document whitespace as the product shape; a second rounded table shell inside the desk card; grey headers that read as disabled; CSS-uppercase column labels; standing keycaps on buttons; a filter strip of hunt tiles.
keyCharacteristics: One white sheet inside a desk card; the grid bleeds to the card edges.
Bottom hairlines only — no vertical column cage.
Caption-dense cells (12px) with condensed 10px headers in black ink.
Interactive facts turn scan-blue and underline; idle facts stay slate ink.
Toolbar splits “what am I looking at” (left) from “how is it drawn” (right).

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Scan Blue is for live facts and interactive ink. It is not a fill for the sheet, the header band, or idle chrome.

rules.name: The Header-Ink Rule
rules.body: A painted DATA header uses Slate Ink, same as the values under it. Grey headers read as disabled.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Header Rule
rules.body: Column labels render in the case the catalog authored. Eyebrows, field labels, and section labels may uppercase; DATA headers may not.

rules.name: The Weight-Cap Rule
rules.body: 700+ is not loaded. Hierarchy is ink + tracking, not extra bold.

rules.name: The One-Plane Rule
rules.body: Toolbar, frozen header, body, and status bar share Card White. Hierarchy is hairline rules, not a sunken header fill.

rules.name: The Flat-Grid Rule
rules.body: Do not raise individual rows or cells. Lift the card, or lift a popover — never the sheet.

rules.name: The No-Box-in-Box Rule
rules.body: Only the desk card carries radius on a pointer desk. The table inside stays edge-to-edge.

dos: Do keep every labeled DATA header click-to-sort, and list those same facts in the toolbar sort menu.
Do mount the filter control beside Search even when a family has no facets.
Do paint column headers in sentence case with Slate Ink at 10px condensed.
Do use caption (12px) for grid facts and Plex Mono for identifiers.
Do let the grid bleed to the desk card; put radius only on that card’s floor.
donts: Don't wrap DataTable in a second rounded / bordered / shadowed shell.
Don't grey out DATA headers, CSS-uppercase them, or set sortable: false on a labeled fact.
Don't draw a vertical column cage or a sunken frozen-header fill.
Don't put FilterRefinementBar, hunt tiles, or a funnel inside SearchField.
Don't use native date inputs or the range-filter picker inside a cell.
Don't invent a second display face, load weight 700, or leave keycaps standing on buttons.
